- [ ] **Step 3: Write `App/AppModel.swift`**

```swift
import AudioTap
import Effects
import Foundation
import GoveeLAN
import Observation
import OSLog
import ServiceManagement

/// The one observable object the whole app reads from.
@MainActor
@Observable
final class AppModel {

    enum Banner: Equatable {
        case noBulbs
        case audioDenied
        case partyPaused(String)
    }

    // MARK: Published state

    private(set) var bulbs: [Bulb] = []
    private(set) var partyState: PartyEngine.State = .off
    private(set) var level: Float = 0
    private(set) var audioPermission: AudioTapPermission = .unknown
    private(set) var settings: GlowbeatSettings

    // MARK: Dependencies

    private let socket: LANSocket
    private let discovery: BulbDiscovery
    private let controller: BulbController
    private let poller: StatusPoller
    private let settingsStore: SettingsStore
    private let nameStore: BulbNameStore
    private let engine: PartyEngine
    private let frameSource: any AudioFrameSource
    private let changeDetector = ExternalChangeDetector()
    private let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.philwoolley.glowbeat", category: "AppModel")

    @ObservationIgnored private var discoveryTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ObservationIgnored private var statusTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ObservationIgnored private var permissionTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ObservationIgnored private var preParty: [String: BulbState] = [:]
    @ObservationIgnored private var isRunning = false

    init(socket: LANSocket,
         discovery: BulbDiscovery,
         controller: BulbController,
         poller: StatusPoller,
         frameSource: any AudioFrameSource,
         tickSource: any TickSource,
         settingsStore: SettingsStore,
         nameStore: BulbNameStore) {
        self.socket = socket
        self.discovery = discovery
        self.controller = controller
        self.poller = poller
        self.frameSource = frameSource
        self.settingsStore = settingsStore
        self.nameStore = nameStore
        self.settings = settingsStore.load()
        self.engine = PartyEngine(controller: controller,
                                  frameSource: frameSource,
                                  tickSource: tickSource)

        engine.onStateChange = { [weak self] newState in
            self?.partyState = newState
        }
        engine.onLevelChange = { [weak self] newLevel in
            self?.level = newLevel
        }
    }

    /// Builds the production object graph.
    static func live() -> AppModel {
        let configuration = LANConfiguration.production
        let socket = LANSocket(configuration: configuration)
        let settingsStore = SettingsStore()
        let settings = settingsStore.load()
        let discovery = BulbDiscovery(socket: socket,
                                      configuration: configuration,
                                      rescanInterval: settings.rescanInterval,
                                      missesBeforeUnreachable: 3)
        let controller = BulbController(
            socket: socket,
            configuration: .init(repeatCount: 3,
                                 repeatInterval: 1.0,
                                 maxStreamedSendsPerSecond: settings.maxUpdatesPerSecond,
                                 recentColorHistoryCount: 5))
        let poller = StatusPoller(socket: socket, configuration: configuration, interval: 10)
        return AppModel(socket: socket,
                        discovery: discovery,
                        controller: controller,
                        poller: poller,
                        frameSource: SystemAudioTap(),
                        tickSource: TimerTickSource(),
                        settingsStore: settingsStore,
                        nameStore: BulbNameStore())
    }

    // MARK: Services

    func startServices() {
        guard !isRunning else { return }
        isRunning = true
        do {
            try socket.start()
        } catch {
            logger.error("Unable to open the LAN socket: \(String(describing: error), privacy: .public)")
        }

        // Every one of these tasks is created from a MainActor method, so it inherits
        // MainActor isolation and can touch `self` directly.
        discoveryTask = Task { [weak self, discovery] in
            await discovery.start()
            for await snapshot in discovery.updates {
                if Task.isCancelled { return }
                guard let self else { return }
                self.applyDiscovered(self.nameStore.sorted(snapshot))
            }
        }
        statusTask = Task { [weak self, poller] in
            await poller.start(bulbs: [])
            for await update in poller.statuses {
                if Task.isCancelled { return }
                self?.applyStatus(update)
            }
        }
        permissionTask = Task { [weak self, frameSource] in
            for await permission in frameSource.permissionUpdates {
                if Task.isCancelled { return }
                self?.audioPermission = permission
            }
        }
    }

    /// Not wired to app termination on purpose. Spec section 4.4 step 4: quitting never
    /// turns bulbs off and never restores anything, so the bulbs keep their last color.
    /// This exists for tests and for a future "disconnect" control.
    func stopServices() {
        guard isRunning else { return }
        isRunning = false
        engine.stop()
        discoveryTask?.cancel()
        statusTask?.cancel()
        permissionTask?.cancel()
        discoveryTask = nil
        statusTask = nil
        permissionTask = nil
        Task { [discovery, poller] in
            await discovery.stop()
            await poller.stop()
        }
        socket.stop()
    }

    func rescan() {
        Task { [discovery] in
            await discovery.scanNow()
        }
    }

    // MARK: Derived text

    var statusLine: String {
        guard !bulbs.isEmpty else { return "No bulbs found." }
        let reachable = bulbs.filter(\.isReachable).count
        let noun = bulbs.count == 1 ? "bulb" : "bulbs"
        let head = reachable == bulbs.count
            ? "\(bulbs.count) \(noun)."
            : "\(reachable) of \(bulbs.count) \(noun) reachable."
        switch partyState {
        case .off:
            return "\(head) Party Mode is off."
        case .running:
            if audioPermission == .deniedOrSilent {
                return "\(head) No audio is reaching Glowbeat."
            }
            return "\(head) Listening to system audio."
        case .paused(let reason):
            return "\(head) \(reason)"
        }
    }

    var banner: Banner? {
        if case .paused(let reason) = partyState { return .partyPaused(reason) }
        if partyState == .running, audioPermission == .deniedOrSilent { return .audioDenied }
        if bulbs.isEmpty { return .noBulbs }
        return nil
    }

    // MARK: Names

    func displayName(for bulb: Bulb) -> String {
        let index = (bulbs.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == bulb.id }) ?? 0) + 1
        return nameStore.name(for: bulb.id, fallback: "Bulb \(index)")
    }

    func setDisplayName(_ name: String, for bulb: Bulb) {
        nameStore.setName(name, for: bulb.id)
        // Republish the array so name observers re render.
        let snapshot = bulbs
        bulbs = snapshot
    }

    // MARK: Bulb controls. A nil bulb means every bulb.

    func setPower(_ on: Bool, for bulb: Bulb?) {
        let targets = resolve(bulb)
        Task { [controller] in await controller.turn(on, bulbs: targets) }
    }

    func setBrightness(_ value: Int, for bulb: Bulb?) {
        let targets = resolve(bulb)
        Task { [controller] in await controller.setBrightness(value, bulbs: targets) }
    }

    func setColor(_ color: Effects.RGB, for bulb: Bulb?) {
        let targets = resolve(bulb)
        let govee = FrameBridge.goveeColor(from: color)
        Task { [controller] in await controller.setColor(govee, bulbs: targets) }
    }

    func setColorTemperature(kelvin: Int, for bulb: Bulb?) {
        let targets = resolve(bulb)
        Task { [controller] in await controller.setColorTemperature(kelvin: kelvin, bulbs: targets) }
    }

    private func resolve(_ bulb: Bulb?) -> [Bulb] {
        guard let bulb else { return bulbs.filter(\.isReachable) }
        return [bulb]
    }

    // MARK: Party Mode

    func setPartyModeEnabled(_ enabled: Bool) {
        if enabled {
            guard partyState == .off else { return }
            preParty = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: bulbs.compactMap { bulb in
                bulb.state.map { (bulb.id, $0) }
            })
            let targets = bulbs.filter(\.isReachable)
            Task { [poller] in
                await poller.updateBulbs(targets)
                await poller.setInterval(1)
            }
            do {
                try engine.start(bulbs: targets,
                                 effect: settings.effectKind,
                                 palette: settings.palette,
                                 sensitivity: settings.sensitivity,
                                 updatesPerSecond: settings.maxUpdatesPerSecond)
            } catch {
                logger.error("Party Mode failed to start: \(String(describing: error), privacy: .public)")
                audioPermission = .deniedOrSilent
            }
        } else {
            engine.stop()
            preParty.removeAll()
            Task { [poller] in await poller.setInterval(10) }
        }
    }

    func resumeParty() {
        engine.resume()
    }

    // MARK: Settings

    func setEffect(_ kind: EffectKind) {
        settings.effectKind = kind
        settingsStore.save(settings)
        engine.setEffect(kind)
    }

    func setPalette(id: String) {
        settings.paletteID = Palette.palette(withID: id).id
        settingsStore.save(settings)
        engine.setPalette(settings.palette)
    }

    func setSensitivity(_ value: Double) {
        settings.sensitivity = min(1, max(0, value))
        settingsStore.save(settings)
        engine.setSensitivity(settings.sensitivity)
    }

    func setShowsMenuBarExtra(_ shows: Bool) {
        settings.showsMenuBarExtra = shows
        settingsStore.save(settings)
    }

    func setLaunchesAtLogin(_ launches: Bool) {
        settings.launchesAtLogin = launches
        settingsStore.save(settings)
        do {
            if launches {
                try SMAppService.mainApp.register()
            } else {
                try SMAppService.mainApp.unregister()
            }
        } catch {
            logger.error("Launch at login change failed: \(String(describing: error), privacy: .public)")
            settings.launchesAtLogin = SMAppService.mainApp.status == .enabled
            settingsStore.save(settings)
        }
    }

    func setRescanInterval(_ seconds: TimeInterval) {
        settings.rescanInterval = min(300, max(15, seconds))
        settingsStore.save(settings)
    }

    func setMaxUpdatesPerSecond(_ value: Int) {
        settings.maxUpdatesPerSecond = min(10, max(2, value))
        settingsStore.save(settings)
        engine.setUpdatesPerSecond(settings.maxUpdatesPerSecond)
    }

    func completeFirstRun() {
        settings.hasCompletedFirstRun = true
        settingsStore.save(settings)
    }

    // MARK: Incoming updates

    private func applyDiscovered(_ snapshot: [Bulb]) {
        bulbs = snapshot
        if nameStore.order().isEmpty, !snapshot.isEmpty {
            nameStore.setOrder(snapshot.map(\.id))
        }
        let targets = snapshot.filter(\.isReachable)
        Task { [poller] in await poller.updateBulbs(targets) }
        if partyState != .off {
            engine.updateBulbs(targets)
        }
    }

    private func applyStatus(_ update: BulbStatusUpdate) {
        guard let index = bulbs.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == update.bulbID }) else { return }
        bulbs[index].state = update.state
        bulbs[index].isReachable = true
        guard partyState == .running else { return }

        let fallback = preParty[update.bulbID]
        Task { [weak self, controller, changeDetector] in
            let expectation = ExternalChangeDetector.Expectation(
                expectedPower: await controller.lastSentPower(for: update.bulbID)
                    ?? fallback?.isOn,
                expectedBrightness: await controller.lastSentBrightness(for: update.bulbID)
                    ?? fallback?.brightness,
                recentColors: await controller.recentSentColors(for: update.bulbID))
            let finding = changeDetector.evaluate(reported: update.state, expectation: expectation)
            guard let reason = finding.reason else { return }
            self?.engine.pause(reason: reason)
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `App/Views/ColorConversion.swift`**

```swift
import AppKit
import Effects
import SwiftUI

extension Color {
    init(effectsRGB color: Effects.RGB) {
        self.init(.sRGB,
                  red: Double(color.r) / 255,
                  green: Double(color.g) / 255,
                  blue: Double(color.b) / 255,
                  opacity: 1)
    }
}

enum ColorConversion {
    /// SwiftUI colors can come from any color space, so convert through sRGB before
    /// taking the channels the bulbs expect.
    static func effectsRGB(from color: Color) -> Effects.RGB {
        let resolved = NSColor(color).usingColorSpace(.sRGB) ?? NSColor.white
        func channel(_ value: CGFloat) -> UInt8 {
            UInt8(min(255, max(0, (value * 255).rounded())))
        }
        return Effects.RGB(r: channel(resolved.redComponent),
                           g: channel(resolved.greenComponent),
                           b: channel(resolved.blueComponent))
    }
}
```

```swift
/// A slim bar that shows Glowbeat is hearing audio. Without it a silent Party Mode is

        .accessibilityLabel("Audio level")
        .accessibilityValue("\(Int(min(1, max(0, level)) * 100)) percent")

}
```

```swift
                .font(.system(size: 34))

                .font(.headline)
            Text("Open Govee Home, tap each bulb, and turn on LAN Control. Then scan again.")
                .font(.callout)

                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                .frame(maxWidth: 320)

/// The row at the top that applies to every reachable bulb at once.
struct AllBulbsRow: View {

    @Bindable var model: AppModel
    @State private var brightness: Double = 100
    @State private var color = Color.white

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            Image(systemName: "lightbulb.2.fill")
                .foregroundStyle(.tint)
            Text("All bulbs")
                .font(.headline)
                .frame(width: 150, alignment: .leading)

            Button("On") { model.setPower(true, for: nil) }
            Button("Off") { model.setPower(false, for: nil) }

            Slider(value: $brightness, in: 0...100) { editing in
                guard !editing else { return }
                model.setBrightness(Int(brightness.rounded()), for: nil)
            }
            .frame(width: 140)
            .help("Brightness for every bulb")

            ColorPicker("", selection: $color, supportsOpacity: false)
                .labelsHidden()
                .onChange(of: color) { _, newValue in
                    model.setColor(ColorConversion.effectsRGB(from: newValue), for: nil)
                }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .padding(.vertical, 10)
        .disabled(model.bulbs.isEmpty)
    }
}

/// One bulb: editable name, reachability, power, brightness, color, color temperature.
struct BulbRow: View {

    @Bindable var model: AppModel
    let bulb: Bulb

    @State private var name = ""
    @State private var brightness: Double = 100
    @State private var kelvin: Double = 4000
    @State private var color = Color.white
    @State private var hasLoaded = false

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            Circle()
                .fill(bulb.isReachable ? Color.green : Color.secondary.opacity(0.4))
                .frame(width: 9, height: 9)
                .help(bulb.isReachable ? "Reachable" : "Not answering. Check Wi-Fi.")

            TextField("Name", text: $name)
                .textFieldStyle(.plain)
                .frame(width: 150, alignment: .leading)
                .onSubmit { model.setDisplayName(name, for: bulb) }

            Toggle("", isOn: Binding(
                get: { bulb.state?.isOn ?? false },
                set: { model.setPower($0, for: bulb) }))
                .labelsHidden()
                .toggleStyle(.switch)

            Slider(value: $brightness, in: 0...100) { editing in
                guard !editing else { return }
                model.setBrightness(Int(brightness.rounded()), for: bulb)
            }
            .frame(width: 140)
            .help("Brightness")

            ColorPicker("", selection: $color, supportsOpacity: false)
                .labelsHidden()
                .onChange(of: color) { _, newValue in
                    model.setColor(ColorConversion.effectsRGB(from: newValue), for: bulb)
                }

            Slider(value: $kelvin, in: 2700...7500) { editing in
                guard !editing else { return }
                model.setColorTemperature(kelvin: Int(kelvin.rounded()), for: bulb)
            }
            .frame(width: 110)
            .help("White temperature, 2700 K to 7500 K")
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .padding(.vertical, 8)
        .opacity(bulb.isReachable ? 1 : 0.45)
        .disabled(!bulb.isReachable)
        .task(id: bulb.id) { loadFromModel() }
        .onChange(of: bulb.state) { _, _ in loadFromModel(force: false) }
    }

    private func loadFromModel(force: Bool = true) {
        if force || !hasLoaded {
            name = model.displayName(for: bulb)
        }
        if let state = bulb.state {
            brightness = Double(state.brightness)
            if state.colorTemperatureKelvin > 0 {
                kelvin = Double(min(7500, max(2700, state.colorTemperatureKelvin)))
            }
            color = Color(effectsRGB: FrameBridge.effectsColor(from: state.color))
        }
        hasLoaded = true
    }
}
```

```swift
struct PartyPanelView: View {

                if case .paused(let reason) = model.partyState {
                    HStack(spacing: 8) {
                        Text(reason)
                            .font(.callout)
                            .foregroundStyle(.orange)
                        Button("Resume") { model.resumeParty() }
                            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
                    }
                }
            }

            Picker("Effect", selection: Binding(get: { model.settings.effectKind },
                                                set: { model.setEffect($0) })) {
                ForEach(EffectKind.allCases) { kind in
                    Text(kind.displayName).tag(kind)
                }
            }
            .pickerStyle(.segmented)
            .help(model.settings.effectKind.summary)

            Picker("Palette", selection: Binding(get: { model.settings.paletteID },
                                                 set: { model.setPalette(id: $0) })) {
                ForEach(Palette.all) { palette in
                    HStack {
                        ForEach(Array(palette.colors.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { entry in
                            Circle()
                                .fill(Color(effectsRGB: entry.element))
                                .frame(width: 10, height: 10)
                        }
                        Text(palette.name)
                    }
                    .tag(palette.id)
                }
            }

            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                Text("Sensitivity")
                Slider(value: Binding(get: { model.settings.sensitivity },
                                      set: { model.setSensitivity($0) }),
                       in: 0...1)
                Text(String(format: "%.0f%%", model.settings.sensitivity * 100))
                    .monospacedDigit()
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .frame(width: 44, alignment: .trailing)
            }

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text("Level")
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                LevelMeter(level: model.level)
            }
        }
        .padding(16)
    }
}
```

```swift
import AppKit
import SwiftUI

struct MainWindowView: View {

    @Bindable var model: AppModel

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            if let banner = model.banner {
                BannerView(model: model, banner: banner)
                Divider()
            }
            BulbListView(model: model)
                .frame(minHeight: 180)
            Divider()
            PartyPanelView(model: model)
            Divider()
            HStack {
                Text(model.statusLine)
                    .font(.callout)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                Spacer()
                Button("Rescan") { model.rescan() }
                    .controlSize(.small)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.vertical, 8)
        }
        .frame(minWidth: 760, minHeight: 520)
    }
}

/// The one banner slot at the top of the window.
struct BannerView: View {

    @Bindable var model: AppModel
    let banner: AppModel.Banner

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 10) {
            Image(systemName: symbol)
                .foregroundStyle(tint)
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                Text(title).font(.callout.weight(.semibold))
                Text(detail).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            Spacer()
            action
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .padding(.vertical, 10)
        .background(tint.opacity(0.08))
    }

    private var symbol: String {
        switch banner {
        case .noBulbs: return "lightbulb.slash"
        case .audioDenied: return "speaker.slash"
        case .partyPaused: return "pause.circle"
        }
    }

    private var tint: Color {
        switch banner {
        case .noBulbs: return .secondary
        case .audioDenied: return .red
        case .partyPaused: return .orange
        }
    }

    private var title: String {
        switch banner {
        case .noBulbs: return "No bulbs found"
        case .audioDenied: return "Glowbeat is not hearing any audio"
        case .partyPaused(let reason): return reason
        }
    }

    private var detail: String {
        switch banner {
        case .noBulbs:
            return "Turn on LAN Control for each bulb in Govee Home, then scan again."
        case .audioDenied:
            return "Allow Glowbeat under Privacy and Security, Screen and System Audio Recording. Also check your Mac is not muted and something is playing."
        case .partyPaused:
            return "Glowbeat stopped sending so it does not fight the Govee app."
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var action: some View {
        switch banner {
        case .noBulbs:
            Button("Scan Again") { model.rescan() }
        case .audioDenied:
            Button("Open Settings") {
                let url = URL(string: "x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?Privacy_ScreenCapture")
                if let url {
                    NSWorkspace.shared.open(url)
                }
            }
        case .partyPaused:
            Button("Resume") { model.resumeParty() }
                .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import XCTest
import Effects
import GoveeLAN
import ServiceManagement
@testable import Glowbeat

@MainActor
final class SettingsSceneTests: XCTestCase {

    private var socket: LANSocket!
    private var suiteName = ""

    private func makeModel() throws -> AppModel {
        let configuration = LANConfiguration(replyPort: 0,
                                             commandPort: .matchingReplySource,
                                             joinsMulticast: false,
                                             extraScanTargets: [])
        socket = LANSocket(configuration: configuration)
        try socket.start()
        suiteName = "glowbeat.tests.\(UUID().uuidString)"
        let defaults = try XCTUnwrap(UserDefaults(suiteName: suiteName))
        return AppModel(socket: socket,
                        discovery: BulbDiscovery(socket: socket, configuration: configuration),
                        controller: BulbController(socket: socket),
                        poller: StatusPoller(socket: socket, configuration: configuration),
                        frameSource: ScriptedFrameSource(),
                        tickSource: ManualTickSource(),
                        settingsStore: SettingsStore(defaults: defaults),
                        nameStore: BulbNameStore(defaults: defaults))
    }

    override func tearDown() async throws {
        socket?.stop()
        socket = nil
        if !suiteName.isEmpty {
            UserDefaults().removePersistentDomain(forName: suiteName)
        }
    }

    func testTheMenuBarExtraIsOffByDefaultAndTogglesOn() throws {
        let model = try makeModel()
        XCTAssertFalse(model.settings.showsMenuBarExtra)
        model.setShowsMenuBarExtra(true)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.settings.showsMenuBarExtra)
    }

    func testTheRescanIntervalIsClampedToFifteenThroughThreeHundred() throws {
        let model = try makeModel()
        model.setRescanInterval(1)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.settings.rescanInterval, 15)
        model.setRescanInterval(9999)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.settings.rescanInterval, 300)
    }

    func testMaxUpdatesPerSecondIsClampedToTwoThroughTen() throws {
        let model = try makeModel()
        model.setMaxUpdatesPerSecond(0)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.settings.maxUpdatesPerSecond, 2)
        model.setMaxUpdatesPerSecond(50)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.settings.maxUpdatesPerSecond, 10)
        model.setMaxUpdatesPerSecond(8)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.settings.maxUpdatesPerSecond, 8)
    }

    func testLaunchAtLoginSettingMatchesTheRegisteredServiceState() throws {
        let model = try makeModel()
        // Registration can legitimately fail under the test host, in which case the model
        // must report the real service state rather than the requested one, never a lie.
        model.setLaunchesAtLogin(true)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.settings.launchesAtLogin,
                       SMAppService.mainApp.status == .enabled)
        model.setLaunchesAtLogin(false)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.settings.launchesAtLogin)
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `App/Views/FirstRunSheet.swift`**

```swift
import GoveeLAN
import SwiftUI

/// Three steps: turn on LAN Control, name the bulbs, done.
///
/// The system audio permission prompt is deliberately not part of first run. It fires the
/// first time Party Mode is switched on, where the user can connect it to what they just
/// asked for.
struct FirstRunSheet: View {

    enum Step: Int, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
        case lanControl
        case naming
        case done

        var id: Int { rawValue }

        var title: String {
            switch self {
            case .lanControl: return "Turn on LAN Control"
            case .naming: return "Name your bulbs"
            case .done: return "You are set"
            }
        }
    }

    @Bindable var model: AppModel
    @Binding var isPresented: Bool
    @State private var step: Step = .lanControl

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                ForEach(Step.allCases) { item in
                    Capsule()
                        .fill(item.rawValue <= step.rawValue ? Color.accentColor
                                                             : Color.secondary.opacity(0.25))
                        .frame(height: 4)
                }
            }

            Text(step.title)
                .font(.title2.weight(.semibold))

            Group {
                switch step {
                case .lanControl: lanControlStep
                case .naming: namingStep
                case .done: doneStep
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)

            Spacer(minLength: 0)

            HStack {
                if step != .lanControl {
                    Button("Back") { goBack() }
                }
                Spacer()
                Button(step == .done ? "Start Using Glowbeat" : "Next") { goForward() }
                    .keyboardShortcut(.defaultAction)
                    .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            }
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(width: 540, height: 420)
    }

    // MARK: Steps

    private var lanControlStep: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
            Image(systemName: "wifi.router")
                .font(.system(size: 40))
                .foregroundStyle(.tint)

            Text("Glowbeat talks to your bulbs directly over Wi-Fi. Each bulb has to be told to allow that, once, in the Govee Home app on your phone.")
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
                Label("Open Govee Home and tap a bulb.", systemImage: "1.circle.fill")
                Label("Tap the settings gear in the top right.", systemImage: "2.circle.fill")
                Label("Turn on LAN Control.", systemImage: "3.circle.fill")
                Label("Repeat for every bulb you want to use.", systemImage: "4.circle.fill")
            }
            .font(.callout)

            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                Button("Scan Now") { model.rescan() }
                Text(model.bulbs.isEmpty
                     ? "No bulbs found yet."
                     : "Found \(model.bulbs.count) \(model.bulbs.count == 1 ? "bulb" : "bulbs").")
                    .foregroundStyle(model.bulbs.isEmpty ? .secondary : .primary)
            }
        }
    }

    private var namingStep: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
            Text("Give each bulb a name you will recognize. You can change these any time.")
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)

            if model.bulbs.isEmpty {
                Text("No bulbs yet. Go back a step and scan again.")
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            } else {
                ScrollView {
                    VStack(spacing: 8) {
                        ForEach(model.bulbs) { bulb in
                            FirstRunNameRow(model: model, bulb: bulb)
                        }
                    }
                }
                .frame(maxHeight: 200)
            }
        }
    }

    private var doneStep: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
            Image(systemName: "checkmark.seal.fill")
                .font(.system(size: 40))
                .foregroundStyle(.green)

            Text("Play something, then switch on Party Mode. The first time you do, macOS will ask to let Glowbeat listen to your Mac's audio. Say yes, or Party Mode will see silence.")
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)

            Text("Glowbeat never turns your bulbs off on quit. They keep whatever color they were last given.")
                .font(.callout)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
        }
    }

    // MARK: Navigation

    private func goForward() {
        guard let next = Step(rawValue: step.rawValue + 1) else {
            model.completeFirstRun()
            isPresented = false
            return
        }
        step = next
    }

    private func goBack() {
        guard let previous = Step(rawValue: step.rawValue - 1) else { return }
        step = previous
    }
}

private struct FirstRunNameRow: View {

    @Bindable var model: AppModel
    let bulb: Bulb
    @State private var name = ""

    var body: some View {
        HStack {
            Circle()
                .fill(bulb.isReachable ? Color.green : Color.secondary.opacity(0.4))
                .frame(width: 8, height: 8)
            TextField("Name", text: $name)
                .textFieldStyle(.roundedBorder)
                .onSubmit { model.setDisplayName(name, for: bulb) }
            Text(bulb.endpoint.host)
                .font(.caption)
                .monospaced()
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
        .task(id: bulb.id) { name = model.displayName(for: bulb) }
    }
}
```

```swift
struct MainWindowView: View {

    @Bindable var model: AppModel
    @State private var showsFirstRun = false

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            if let banner = model.banner {
                BannerView(model: model, banner: banner)
                Divider()
            }
            BulbListView(model: model)
                .frame(minHeight: 180)
            Divider()
            PartyPanelView(model: model)
            Divider()
            HStack {
                Text(model.statusLine)
                    .font(.callout)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                Spacer()
                Button("Rescan") { model.rescan() }
                    .controlSize(.small)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.vertical, 8)
        }
        .frame(minWidth: 760, minHeight: 520)
        .onAppear { showsFirstRun = !model.settings.hasCompletedFirstRun }
        .sheet(isPresented: $showsFirstRun) {
            FirstRunSheet(model: model, isPresented: $showsFirstRun)
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 22: On hardware verification with Phil's six bulbs

**Files:**
- Create: `docs/manual-hardware-checklist.md`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the finished app from Tasks 1 to 21.
- Produces: `docs/manual-hardware-checklist.md`, filled in with real results, and a list of any defects to fix before Task 23.

**Rules for running this task:**
- **Warn then run.** Before every item that changes a real light, tell Phil in one short line exactly what is about to happen and what to watch for, then wait ten seconds, then run it. Bulbs jumping unannounced is startling and makes it impossible to tell a bug from the app working.
- **Look at the lights.** UDP has no acknowledgement and Govee firmware acknowledges commands it ignores. A green build proves nothing about a bulb. Every item is judged by what Phil sees.
- **A failure stops the task.** Write it down, fix it with a test first (the bug fix rule), and rerun the item.

- [ ] **Step 1: Build a fresh signed app and confirm it is signed**

```bash
cd ~/Projects/glowbeat
xcodebuild -project Glowbeat.xcodeproj -scheme Glowbeat -configuration Debug \
  -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData build
codesign -dv --verbose=2 build/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug/Glowbeat.app 2>&1 \
  | grep -E "Authority|TeamIdentifier|flags"
plutil -p build/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug/Glowbeat.app/Contents/Info.plist \
  | grep NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription
```

Expected: an Apple Development authority, Phil's Personal Team identifier, `runtime` in
flags, and the audio usage description. An unsigned build never keeps the audio grant.

- [ ] **Step 2: Item 1, discovery finds six bulbs within three seconds**

Say to Phil: "I am launching Glowbeat. Nothing will change on your lights. Watch the bulb
list fill in." Wait ten seconds. Then:

```bash
cd ~/Projects/glowbeat
open build/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug/Glowbeat.app
```

Three seconds after the window appears, screenshot and count:

```bash
screencapture -x -o ~/Desktop/glowbeat-hw-1-discovery.png
open -a Preview ~/Desktop/glowbeat-hw-1-discovery.png
```

Record: how many bulbs appeared, and how long it took. Pass means six bulbs inside three
seconds. If macOS shows a Local Network permission prompt, allow it and note that the
prompt appeared; it is expected on macOS 15 and later and is why `NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription`
is in the Info.plist.

- [ ] **Step 3: Item 2, per bulb and All controls change the real bulbs**

Say to Phil: "I am about to switch every bulb on, set them to 60 percent, and turn them
red, then change only the first bulb to blue. Watch the room." Wait ten seconds. Then do
it from the app window: All row On, All brightness to 60, All color to red, then the first
bulb's color well to blue.

Record: whether each change happened, roughly how fast, and whether the reachability dots
stayed green. Then check the readback: the brightness slider and color well of each row
should settle on what was just set, because `devStatus` polls every ten seconds outside
Party Mode. Pass means the lights match and the readback matches.

- [ ] **Step 4: Item 3, Party Mode with music, all three effects**

Say to Phil: "Start some music with a clear beat. I am turning on Party Mode. The first
time, macOS will ask to let Glowbeat record system audio. Allow it. Then watch whether the
bulbs follow the beat." Wait ten seconds. Then turn Party Mode on in the app.

Run each effect for about thirty seconds: Pulse, then Spread, then Wave.

Record for each: does the level meter move, do the bulbs visibly follow the beat, and for
Spread do different bulbs respond to different parts of the music, and for Wave does the
color visibly travel from bulb to bulb. Pass means all three read as deliberate, not random.

If the level meter sits at zero, that is the audio permission path, not the LAN path: check
Privacy and Security, Screen and System Audio Recording for Glowbeat, and confirm the Mac
is not muted.

- [ ] **Step 5: Item 4, the sensitivity slider visibly changes the rate**

Say to Phil: "Same music, Party Mode still on. I am going to drag sensitivity to the far
left, then the far right. Watch how often the lights react." Wait ten seconds. Then drag to
0, watch for twenty seconds, drag to 1, watch for twenty seconds.

Record: fewer reactions at 0 and more at 1. Pass means the difference is obvious without
being told which end is which.

- [ ] **Step 6: Item 5, phone takeover pauses inside two seconds**

Say to Phil: "Party Mode stays on. Please open Govee Home and change the brightness of any
one bulb. I am timing how long Glowbeat takes to notice and pause." Wait ten seconds. Then
have Phil make the change.

Record: the wall clock time from his change to the Paused banner appearing, and the exact
wording of the reason. Pass means under two seconds with a sensible message. Then press
Resume and confirm the lights start following the music again.

Also try a phone scene, since the spec calls this out as unverified: have Phil start a
Govee scene on one bulb during Party Mode and record whether it is detected. If a scene is
not detectable, do not invent a fix. Write it into the checklist as a known limitation
exactly as spec section 4.4 allows.

- [ ] **Step 7: Item 6, the audio denied path shows the banner**

Say to Phil: "I am going to revoke Glowbeat's audio permission so we can see the error
state. Your lights will not change." Wait ten seconds. Then:

```bash
tccutil reset ScreenCapture com.philwoolley.glowbeat
```

Quit and relaunch Glowbeat, turn Party Mode on, and deny the prompt (or dismiss it).
Within about three seconds the red "Glowbeat is not hearing any audio" banner should appear
with a working Open Settings button.

Record: whether the banner appeared, how long it took, and whether Open Settings landed on
the right pane. Then grant the permission again and confirm the banner clears.

- [ ] **Step 8: Item 7, the menu bar toggle works without a restart**

Already covered in Task 20 Step 7. Repeat it once here on the same build so every item in
spec section 6 is verified against one binary, and record the result.

- [ ] **Step 9: Write the checklist document**

Create `docs/manual-hardware-checklist.md` with the real results. Template, to be filled
in, not shipped with the placeholders:

```markdown
# Glowbeat on hardware checklist

Run on: <date>
Build: Debug, <commit sha>
Bulbs: 6 x Govee H6004, firmware wifiVersionSoft 1.01.27
Mac: macOS <version>, <model>

| # | Item | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Discovery finds 6 bulbs within 3 s of launch | pass or fail | seconds observed |
| 2 | Per bulb and All controls change the real bulbs, readback matches | pass or fail | |
| 3 | Party Mode, Pulse follows the beat | pass or fail | |
| 3 | Party Mode, Spread splits across bulbs | pass or fail | |
| 3 | Party Mode, Wave travels bulb to bulb | pass or fail | |
| 4 | Sensitivity visibly changes how often bulbs react | pass or fail | |
| 5 | Phone brightness change pauses Party Mode within 2 s | pass or fail | seconds observed |
| 5 | Phone scene is detected as an external change | pass, fail or known limitation | |
| 6 | Audio denied path shows the banner | pass or fail | |
| 7 | Menu bar toggle shows and hides without restart | pass or fail | |

## Known limitations

<one line each, or "none">

## Defects found and fixed

<commit sha and one line each, or "none">
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Fix anything that failed, test first**

For each failure: write a failing test that reproduces it at the lowest level that can hold
it (a `GoveeLAN` test with `FakeBulb`, an `Effects` test with a scripted frame sequence, or
an app test with `ScriptedFrameSource`), make it pass, rebuild, and rerun only that
checklist item. Do not batch fixes; one defect, one test, one commit.

- [ ] **Step 11: Codex review of the finished code**

Spec section 6 requires a Codex review before Phil's first real install. Hand Codex the
full diff from Task 1 through Task 22 and ask specifically for:

- Swift 6 concurrency correctness around `LANSocket`, `FakeBulb` and `SystemAudioTap`,
  which are the three `@unchecked Sendable` types in the codebase.
- CoreAudio teardown order and leaks in `SystemAudioTap.start()` failure paths.
- Whether `BulbDiscovery` can ever drop a bulb rather than only marking it unreachable.
- Whether `PartyEngine` can send after `pause()` or after `stop()`.

Log each finding, fix it with a failing test first, and rerun the affected checklist item.

- [ ] **Step 12: Commit**

```bash
git add docs/manual-hardware-checklist.md
git commit -m "$(cat <<'MSG'
docs: record the on hardware verification results for six H6004 bulbs

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01B3VyjvQPtLjJ8x4PSU7gWZ
MSG
)"
```

### Task 23: Notarized build for direct download (later, when ready for others)

**Do not run this task while Glowbeat is only for Phil.** A Developer ID signed and
notarized build is only needed the first time the app is handed to someone else. Running it
early costs nothing but produces an artifact nobody uses, and it changes the signing
identity, which resets the audio capture permission grant on Phil's Mac.

**Files:**
- Create: `docs/notarization.md`
- Modify: `project.yml` (add a `Release` configuration override for Developer ID signing)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the verified app from Task 22.
- Produces: `Glowbeat.zip`, a notarized and stapled app, plus `docs/notarization.md` recording the exact commands and the profile name used.

**Prerequisite:** a Developer ID Application certificate for the Personal Team must exist in
the login keychain. Check first, and stop and tell Phil if it is missing rather than
creating one unattended.

- [ ] **Step 1: Confirm a Developer ID Application identity exists**

```bash
security find-identity -v -p codesigning | grep "Developer ID Application"
```

Expected: one line for Phil's Personal Team. If there is none, stop. Tell Phil that a
Developer ID Application certificate has to be created in his Apple Developer account for
the Personal Team (`Phil's Personal Team account`) before this task can run, and that direct
download distribution is blocked until then.

- [ ] **Step 2: Store a notarytool credential profile**

Glowbeat notarizes under the Personal Team, so the profile is named for it. Phil supplies
an app specific password from appleid.apple.com.

```bash
xcrun notarytool store-credentials "glowbeat-personal" \
  --apple-id "Phil's Personal Team account" \
  --team-id "<the Team ID from Task 1>" \
  --password "<app specific password>"
```

Do not paste the password into a file, a commit, or the plan. Verify the profile:

```bash
xcrun notarytool history --keychain-profile "glowbeat-personal" | head -20
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Add Developer ID signing to the Release configuration in `project.yml`**

Add this `configs`-scoped block to the `Glowbeat` target's `settings` in `project.yml`,
keeping the existing `base` block as it is:

```yaml
    settings:
      base:
        PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: com.philwoolley.glowbeat
        PRODUCT_NAME: Glowbeat
        GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: NO
        INFOPLIST_FILE: App/Info.plist
        CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS: App/Glowbeat.entitlements
        COMBINE_HIDPI_IMAGES: YES
        ENABLE_PREVIEWS: YES
      configs:
        Release:
          CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY: "Developer ID Application"
          CODE_SIGN_STYLE: Manual
          OTHER_CODE_SIGN_FLAGS: "--timestamp --options=runtime"
```

Then regenerate and archive:

```bash
cd ~/Projects/glowbeat
xcodegen generate
xcodebuild -project Glowbeat.xcodeproj -scheme Glowbeat -configuration Release \
  -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData \
  -archivePath build/Glowbeat.xcarchive archive
```

Expected: `** ARCHIVE SUCCEEDED **`, zero warnings.

- [ ] **Step 4: Export the app with an ExportOptions plist**

Create `build/ExportOptions.plist`, substituting the real Team ID:

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>method</key>
	<string>developer-id</string>
	<key>teamID</key>
	<string>REPLACE_WITH_TEAM_ID</string>
	<key>signingStyle</key>
	<string>automatic</string>
	<key>destination</key>
	<string>export</string>
</dict>
</plist>
```

```bash
cd ~/Projects/glowbeat
xcodebuild -exportArchive \
  -archivePath build/Glowbeat.xcarchive \
  -exportOptionsPlist build/ExportOptions.plist \
  -exportPath build/export
```

Expected: `build/export/Glowbeat.app` exists.

- [ ] **Step 5: Verify the signature and the Hardened Runtime before submitting**

```bash
cd ~/Projects/glowbeat
codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 build/export/Glowbeat.app
codesign -dv --verbose=4 build/export/Glowbeat.app 2>&1 | grep -E "Authority|flags|TeamIdentifier"
codesign -d --entitlements - build/export/Glowbeat.app 2>&1 | grep audio-input
```

Expected: valid on disk, satisfies its Designated Requirement, a `Developer ID Application`
authority, `flags=0x10000(runtime)`, and the audio input entitlement. Notarization rejects
anything without the Hardened Runtime.

- [ ] **Step 6: Zip, submit, wait, and staple**

```bash
cd ~/Projects/glowbeat
ditto -c -k --keepParent build/export/Glowbeat.app build/Glowbeat.zip
xcrun notarytool submit build/Glowbeat.zip \
  --keychain-profile "glowbeat-personal" \
  --wait
```

Expected: `status: Accepted`. If it is `Invalid`, pull the log and fix the named issue
rather than guessing:

```bash
xcrun notarytool log <submission-id> --keychain-profile "glowbeat-personal"
```

Then staple the ticket onto the app and re zip the stapled copy, because the ticket lives
in the `.app`, not in the zip that was submitted:

```bash
cd ~/Projects/glowbeat
xcrun stapler staple build/export/Glowbeat.app
xcrun stapler validate build/export/Glowbeat.app
rm build/Glowbeat.zip
ditto -c -k --keepParent build/export/Glowbeat.app build/Glowbeat.zip
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Prove Gatekeeper accepts it the way a stranger's Mac would**

```bash
cd ~/Projects/glowbeat
spctl --assess --type execute --verbose=4 build/export/Glowbeat.app
xattr -w com.apple.quarantine "0081;00000000;Safari;" build/Glowbeat.zip
rm -rf /tmp/glowbeat-gatekeeper-check
mkdir -p /tmp/glowbeat-gatekeeper-check
ditto -x -k build/Glowbeat.zip /tmp/glowbeat-gatekeeper-check
spctl --assess --type execute --verbose=4 /tmp/glowbeat-gatekeeper-check/Glowbeat.app
```

Expected: both assessments print `accepted` with `source=Notarized Developer ID`. This is
the only check that proves a download on someone else's Mac opens without a warning.

- [ ] **Step 8: Write `docs/notarization.md`**

Record, with the real values filled in: the Team ID used, the keychain profile name
(`glowbeat-personal`), the exact archive, export, submit and staple commands above, where
`build/Glowbeat.zip` ends up, and one line saying that the Developer ID identity differs
from the development identity, so the first launch after switching asks for the system audio
permission again. Do not record the app specific password anywhere.

- [ ] **Step 9: Commit**

```bash
git add project.yml docs/notarization.md
git commit -m "$(cat <<'MSG'
build: add Developer ID release signing and record the notarization steps

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01B3VyjvQPtLjJ8x4PSU7gWZ
MSG
)"
```

## Out of scope, confirmed against spec section 5

These are deliberately absent from every task above: Bluetooth transport, Govee cloud
login, Govee scenes, DIY modes, schedules, custom palettes, per bulb effect assignment,
screen color sync, App Store distribution, the App Sandbox, other Govee SKUs beyond
recording the `sku` string from discovery, and any payment.
